topic: SBI Group MixSeek multi-agent framework as reference architecture for Barrot's nine-platform mission

ownership.evidence: SBI Group's Dec 23, 2025 release says AlpacaTech is a subsidiary of FOLIO Holdings, an SBI Group company, and launched MixSeek.

public_product.name: MixSeek
public_product.description: Multi-agent competition/orchestration platform. Different LLM agents analyze the same task; an evaluator automatically selects the highest-ranked output.
public_product.deployment: Snowflake or cloud; Streamlit-based UI; agent workflow and Deep Research data access
public_product.related_product: MixSeek AI Data Lake, announced 2026-05-18, combines MixSeek with Anthropic financial-services agent skills and public Japanese financial data such as TDnet and EDINET. SBI release says customers may use their own ChatGPT (Codex), Claude or Gemini.

security_review: Prompt-injection sanitization utility treats member submissions as untrusted data
Security tests include path-traversal and error/secret handling
Code-execution member uses Anthropic CodeExecutionTool; external execution/data-egress boundary needs separate review

coverage_against_barrot_nine.note: The MixSeek product announcement names Snowflake/cloud, not Databricks. A product-level mention of Codex in the MixSeek AI Data Lake release does not establish a standalone Codex API adapter.

strengths: Provider API abstraction for four target model families
public financial disclosure ingestion workflows in MixSeek AI Data Lake
limitations: Alpha software; not production maturity evidence
Python 3.13.7+ may not match Barrot runtime
winner-selection/leaderboard emphasis can suppress minority objections unless separately retained
no verified XRP point-in-time feature store
no leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation or calibrated predictive performance
no native adapters verified for Copilot, Hugging Face, Kaggle or Databricks
LLM-as-judge scores are not factual verification or market-model performance
architecture_assessment.integration_recommendation: Use as an architecture reference and optional adapter candidate only. Do not add as a dependency until Barrot's Python version, Pydantic AI version, security boundary, license attribution, tool permissions, data egress, cost and CI compatibility are tested.

required_barrot_extensions: point-in-time eligibility and immutable feature snapshots
evidence-based adjudication, not majority vote or one-winner-only output
fixed-horizon forecasts, walk-forward backtesting and calibration
barrot_adaptation.decision: DESIGNED reference architecture; no MixSeek code imported or executed in B-Agent.
